_about: Furfural (1) + gamma-Valerolactone (2): isobaric T-x-y at 30.0 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of furfural, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of furfural, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: J.-P. Pokki, H. Q. Le, P. Uusi-Kyyny, H. Sixta, V. Alopaeus, Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium of Furfural + gamma-Valerolactone at 30 kPa and Isothermal Liquid-Liquid Equilibrium of Carbon Dioxide + gamma-Valerolactone + Water at 298 K, J. Chem. Eng. Data 63 (2018) 4381-4391
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 3, 4. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0035. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.06 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
